claims.title: reachable decoder iff trace fibers preserve the requested answer
claims.statement: A decoder on Set.range trace exists exactly when equal trace values have equal answers; uniqueness is not checked here.
assumptions: classical choice for a representative of each reachable trace value
claims.countercase: PAL23-IF-02 proves a conditional obstruction from supplied conflicting inputs; it does not construct those inputs.
claims.authority_ceiling: Conditional set-theoretic factorization only; no totalization, computability, source existence, authority, or PAL adoption.
claims.residual: Decoder uniqueness, unreachable ambient values, decoder class, and question adequacy are not modeled.
claims.reopening: Change W, T, Q, trace, answer, reachable decoder domain, or requested decoder class.

claims.title: trace collision prevents a reachable decoder when answers differ
claims.statement: A pair with equal trace and unequal answer refutes existence of a reachable decoder.
assumptions: an equality of their trace values
an inequality of their requested answers
claims.countercase: Conditional obstruction only: the collision witnesses are hypotheses, not an instantiated finite countermodel.
claims.authority_ceiling: Logical obstruction only; no claim about empirical detectability or source identity.
claims.residual: No finite enumeration or auxiliary-label repair is checked.
claims.reopening: Change the trace, answer, collision witnesses, or decoder domain.

claims.title: unqualified totalization fails with empty source and nonempty ambient interface
claims.statement: For an explicit Empty source trace into nonempty Bool ambient space and Empty answer space, no ambient total decoder exists.
claims.countercase: Empty source with Bool ambient and Empty answer codomain blocks total extension.
claims.authority_ceiling: Refutes only an unqualified total-decoder generalization; it does not classify separately supplied totalizations.
claims.residual: The empty source is encoded in the fixture explanation rather than a source-map parameter.
claims.reopening: Change source, ambient codomain, answer codomain, or totalization requirements.

claims.title: freeze is injective under a thaw left inverse
claims.statement: If thaw (freeze work) equals work for every declared work state, freeze is injective.
claims.countercase: Without the left-inverse assumption, a constant freeze map need not be injective.
claims.authority_ceiling: Work-state algebra only; no token authority, transport validity, or non-work recovery.
claims.residual: Serialization, environment, suffix determinism, and lineage authority remain external assumptions.
claims.reopening: Change capsule fields, maps, work-state scope, or the left-inverse law.

claims.title: same suffix function respects the exact freeze/thaw equality
claims.statement: Any supplied suffix applied after thaw-freeze equals that suffix on the original work state.
source_refs: PAL v2.3-T P1237-P1240 T63@2.3 (algebraic component only)
claims.countercase: A changed suffix function is outside the theorem and does not support terminal equality.
claims.authority_ceiling: Terminal work equality under the named suffix only; no equality of audit, grant, resource, authority, or external effect.
claims.residual: No serialization, resumed execution, environmental determinism, or complete FX64 re-entry fixture is verified.
claims.reopening: Change suffix, capsule map, work scope, or serialization law.

claims.title: Boolean identity round-trip fixture
claims.statement: For every Boolean work value, id (id work) = work; the two identity functions instantiate the mathematical round-trip law only.
claims.countercase: This finite identity fixture does not establish general serialization.
claims.authority_ceiling: A finite fixture only; no A12 token authority or production checkpoint claim.
claims.residual: No capsule fields, serialization, stored bytes, environment identity, grant token, or implemented freeze/thaw mechanism is modeled.
claims.reopening: Replace the Boolean identity fixture or its maps.

claims.title: heartbeat preserves the declared work coordinate
claims.statement: The finite heartbeat fixture leaves idle.work unchanged.
assumptions: the declared HeartbeatState and heartbeat transition
claims.countercase: PAL23-STUT-02 shows this projected equality is not total-state equality.
claims.authority_ceiling: One work projection equality only; no progress, liveness, success, or closure.
claims.residual: No external export or observation coverage is modeled.
claims.reopening: Change state coordinates, work projection, idle state, or heartbeat transition.

claims.title: heartbeat has hidden total-state motion
claims.statement: The heartbeat fixture changes total state while preserving work.
assumptions: the declared audit increment, spent-resource increment, and grant transition
claims.countercase: Fixed work with changed audit/resource/grant coordinates is the predecessor counterfixture.
claims.authority_ceiling: A finite product-state countermodel; no statement about all heartbeats or systems.
claims.residual: Resource semantics and authority meaning are represented only as coordinates.
claims.reopening: Change heartbeat fields or total-state equality.

claims.title: one heartbeat does not change the declared progress coordinate
claims.statement: The fixture's Boolean-work progress coordinate is unchanged by heartbeat.
claims.countercase: Boundary example supporting this exact theorem and opposing the broader claim that administrative heartbeat recurrence certifies progress. No productive-transition model is supplied.
claims.authority_ceiling: Fixture-local classification only; no fairness or liveness conclusion.
claims.residual: Rank, acceptance, schedule, and observation horizon are not represented.
claims.reopening: Change progress projection or transition classification.
claims.source_scope: Partial negative/boundary example motivating the A13 card; no full administrative/productive relation, cadence, rank, or fairness realization.

claims.title: finite heartbeat loop has no declared progress
claims.statement: For every natural iterate count n, heartbeat iteration starting at the specific idle fixture preserves its declared progress projection.
claims.countercase: Boundary example supporting this exact theorem and opposing the broader claim that administrative heartbeat recurrence certifies progress. No productive-transition model is supplied.
claims.authority_ceiling: Finite recurrence result only; no infinite liveness, fairness, or termination claim.
claims.residual: Scheduler and productive relation are not modeled beyond this transition.
claims.reopening: Change iteration semantics, transition class, or progress projection.
claims.source_scope: Partial negative/boundary example motivating the A13 card; no full administrative/productive relation, cadence, rank, or fairness realization.

claims.title: work restoration leaves the changed spent/grant fields in the fixture
claims.statement: A work-coordinate restoration after heartbeat retains changed spent and grant fields.
source_refs: PAL v2.3-M P1415-P1427 M-RETURN-PROJ (work/total-state separation only)
assumptions: declared product state with Bool and Nat coordinates
heartbeat consumes one fixture unit and changes grantLive
claims.countercase: Same work with altered resource and grant coordinates refutes total-state recovery from work restoration.
claims.authority_ceiling: One concrete counterexample using modeled spent/grant fields; no claim about actual resource accounts, authorization, or every re-entry.
claims.residual: Nat spent and Bool grantLive are modeled coordinates; no budget-minus-consumption slack equation, grant epochs, top-up ledger, or real authorization record is checked.
claims.reopening: Change restore policy, resource/grant coordinate, or heartbeat transition.

claims.title: work restoration is not total-state recovery
claims.statement: The restored fixture state remains unequal to the pre-heartbeat state.
claims.authority_ceiling: Finite equality counterfixture only; no broader transport judgment.
claims.residual: No audit receipt, token lineage, or external terminal effect is encoded.
claims.reopening: Change state equality, restore policy, or non-work transition fields.
